name: Neat Turkey 32
author: AmIt-DasIT
description: Outlined pill white radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes 3px 3px 6px #000000,
   -1px -1px 4px #ffffff,
   inset 3px 3px 6px #000000,
   inset -1px -1px 4px #ffffff, transform becomes scale(1.1).
